{{Article header|section=Ships & Equipment|context=Ships|deck=Large Surface Recon Vehicle built for planetary surface mining.}}
{{SRV infobox}}

The '''Rhino''' is a large [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]] (SRV) manufactured by [[Vodel]] for planetary [[Surface Mining|Surface Mining]]. It is deployed through the [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]], carries up to three Commanders, and is equipped with dedicated mining systems for locating deposits, deploying mining rigs, refining extracted material, and returning commodity cargo to the ship.<ref name="frontier-4410">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous - 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 3 September 2026. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref><ref name="frontier-rhino-arx">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/rhino-available-now-arx-early-access Rhino - Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments, 2 September 2026. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref>

== Overview ==

The Rhino is the first new SRV introduced after the [[Scorpion]] and expands SRV gameplay into a mining-focused planetary loop.<ref name="frontier-first-look">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/beneath-surface-your-first-look-rhino Beneath the Surface - Your First Look at the Rhino], Frontier Developments, 6 August 2026. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref><ref name="frontier-august-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref> Frontier describes it as a heavy-duty Vodel vehicle for Commanders who prefer extraction over exploration, with rugged handling, exceptional suspension, deployable mining rigs, a scanner, and multi-crew capability for up to three occupants.<ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" />

This article describes the Rhino as a vehicle. For step-by-step mining instructions, carrier-ship selection, fitting guidance, troubleshooting, and workflow advice, see [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]].

== Design and characteristics ==

Frontier's equipment page lists the Rhino with top speed 45 m/s, mass 50 T, fuel capacity 0.80 T, armour 324, shields 80, size LRG, two additional multi-crew seats, and cargo capacity 72 T.<ref name="store-vehicle">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/vehicles/rhino Rhino], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref> Other numerical limits, including refinery capacity, mining-rig capacity, and exact storage overflow behaviour, should not be added until they are verified from current game data or authoritative documentation.

Frontier's first-look article describes the Rhino as a six-wheeled, heavy-duty SRV with a three-seat cockpit and no accessible interior space.<ref name="frontier-first-look" />

== Surface-mining equipment ==

Frontier's 4.4.1.0 update notes list the Rhino's major built-in systems as a '''Planetary Mining Deposit Scanner''', '''Refinery''', and '''Mining Rig Deployment Module'''.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> Frontier's Rhino storefront and ARX pages also describe the scanner as a '''Planetary Mineral Scanner'''.<ref name="store-vehicle" /><ref name="store-standard">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/product/rhino-standard Rhino Standard], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 2026-09-03.</ref> EDFM therefore treats Planetary Mining Deposit Scanner as the current release-notes system name while retaining [[Planetary Mineral Scanner]] as the related equipment page until the in-game UI terminology is fully reconciled.

=== Planetary Mining Deposit Scanner ===

{{Main|Planetary Mineral Scanner}}

[[File:planetary_mining_deposits.png|thumb|left|300px|Planetary mining deposits identified by the Rhino's scanner.]]

The Rhino's scanner detects planetary mining deposits and marks mineral-rich areas so the vehicle can be positioned for extraction. The scanner is used after a suitable Planetary Mining Location has been found. Frontier confirms that the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] detects Planetary Mining Locations on planets, and that the Rhino's scanner identifies the deposits within those areas for mining-rig placement.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" /> Detailed controls, exact range, and any scanner tuning values should remain on the scanner or field-procedure page once verified.

<div style="clear: left;"></div>

=== Mining Rig Deployment Module ===

The Rhino includes a Mining Rig Deployment Module for placing mining rigs on suitable planetary deposits.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> Deployment controls, invalid-placement causes, spacing observations, and field workflow belong on [[Surface Mining with the Rhino#Deploying a mining rig|Deploying a mining rig]].

=== Mining rigs ===

[[File:Mining_rig.png|thumb|right|300px|A deployed Rhino mining rig extracting material from a planetary deposit.]]

The Rhino deploys mining rigs at suitable planetary mining deposits. Frontier's release material confirms deployable mining rigs and a Mining Rig Deployment Module as part of the Rhino's Surface Mining equipment.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" />

Until the remaining placement details are fully documented, the confirmed and community-tested points should be kept distinct:

* Rigs are deployed from the Rhino at suitable planetary mining deposits.
* Rigs extract material over time.
* Multiple rigs can operate concurrently; Frontier's Rhino Standard store page says multiple Mining Rigs can be set up at the same time.<ref name="store-standard" />
* Completed output is recovered by the Rhino.
* Large deposits may support more than one rig if enough valid placement area and separation exists, but this specific same-deposit behaviour remains community-tested until Frontier documents the placement rule.

For deployment, recovery, spacing, and workflow details, see [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]].

=== Refinery ===

Frontier's 4.4.1.0 update notes list an onboard Refinery as one of the Rhino's built-in systems.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> In the Surface Mining loop, recovered rig output is processed by the Rhino into commodity cargo that can be transferred back to the ship. Frontier's equipment page lists Rhino cargo capacity as 72 T.<ref name="store-vehicle" />

Surface Mining can also produce additional [[Microresources]] in addition to commodity output. Frontier's release notes explicitly list the frequency of additional Microresources as a Surface Mining balance value.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> These should be treated as secondary output from the mining process, not as evidence that Rhino mining is the fastest or best raw-material farming method.

Exact refinery capacity, chunk-to-commodity conversion details, overflow behaviour, and Microresource rates should not be stated as permanent values until verified through current game data or official documentation.

== Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar ==

{{Main|Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar}}

The Rhino requires a [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]] and cannot be carried in a standard [[Planetary Vehicle Hangar]]. Frontier states that the Rhino is too large to deploy through the regular SRV cargo-hatch workflow and instead drops from the large planetary vehicle bay.<ref name="frontier-first-look" /> The Rhino Standard store page says the Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar is required, not included in the bundle, and available for compatible ships at most outfitting locations for free with the bundle.<ref name="store-standard" />

Only certain ships support the Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar. For the compatible-ship list, fitting requirements, and guidance on choosing a carrier ship, see [[Surface Mining with the Rhino#Choosing a ship|Choosing a ship]].

== Crew ==

The Rhino supports up to three occupants. Frontier's store and ARX pages describe multi-crew capability for up to three Commanders, and the equipment page lists two additional multi-crew seats.<ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" /><ref name="store-vehicle" />

EDFM does not yet have enough verified public information to document seat-specific mining controls, reward sharing, ownership requirements, or detailed permission behaviour. Until those behaviours are tested or documented, state only that additional Commanders can travel in the Rhino; do not assume passengers can operate every scanner, rig, refinery, or cargo function.

== Availability ==

The Rhino released on 2 September 2026 via ARX Early Access.<ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" /> Frontier's 4.4.1.0 update notes for the Rhino release were published on 3 September 2026.<ref name="frontier-4410" />

The current Standard ARX offering provides gameplay access to the Rhino SRV and related unlocks. Frontier's Standard store page lists the Rhino Standard pre-built vehicle at 16,520 ARX, not available on Legacy, and says it includes the Rhino SRV Surface Mining Vehicle, Mining Rig, Rhino Outfitting Unlock, and Rhino Owners Club Decal. It also notes that Odyssey is required for disembarking from the Rhino into on-foot content.<ref name="store-standard" /> Frontier also offers Stellar and Galactic Rhino editions with additional cosmetic contents; these storefront package details are secondary to the vehicle's gameplay role and should not turn this article into a full ARX catalogue.<ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" />

== Development history ==

Frontier officially revealed the Rhino in the 6 August 2026 article "Beneath the Surface - Your First Look at the Rhino", describing it as a colossal SRV built around the then-new Surface Mining activity and previewing its large size, six-wheel design, mining role, and three-seat cockpit.<ref name="frontier-first-look" />

Frontier's 27 August 2026 developer log provided additional details, including the 2 September 2026 release date, Vodel manufacturer attribution, ARX Early Access contents, the Planetary Mineral Scanner, Surface Mining deposit behaviour, and the Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar compatibility list.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" />

The Rhino became available via ARX Early Access on 2 September 2026, followed by Frontier's 4.4.1.0 update notes on 3 September 2026 documenting the released Rhino systems, Surface Mining balance areas, Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar compatibility, and the launch-day 9-to-12 chunk known issue.<ref name="frontier-rhino-arx" /><ref name="frontier-4410" />
